Population increased in Trafford

The estimated population of Trafford in 2024 was 241,025 usual residents, a rise of 0.9% since 2023.

This meant that Trafford's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Trafford increased by 2.3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Trafford was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Trafford

The average (median) age fell to 40.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Trafford has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Trafford is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Trafford's population of 241,025 usual residents was made up of:

  • 50,230 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.8%)
  • 148,280 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.5%)
  • 42,515 people aged 65 years and over, (17.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Trafford has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (20.8% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Trafford, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Trafford
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Trafford, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 55 people (0%). In total, there were 2,153 births and 2,098 deaths in Trafford.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 56 (0%). There were 14,879 people entering the area and 14,823 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Trafford's population of 1,930 (0.8%) as a result of 3,045 people entering the area and 1,115 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Trafford was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Trafford in mid-2023 is 238,976.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,004 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 492 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,496 people.
